provider.name: Tencent
provider.description: Tencent's Hy model family (Hunyuan); served by the Tencent MaaS TokenHub platform, which also aggregates third-party models.

authentication.notes: Environment variable HUNYUAN_API_KEY (created in the TokenHub console). Regional base URLs: https://tokenhub.tencentmaas.com/v1 (Guangzhou) and https://tokenhub-intl.tencentmaas.com/v1 (Singapore). The Anthropic-compatible path /v1/messages authenticates with the x-api-key header instead. The legacy Hunyuan API at https://api.hunyuan.cloud.tencent.com/v1 is scheduled to shut down on 2026-09-30.
